Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Manisha Bhandari, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Bhaskar Ch. Joshi, learned AGA with Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned B.H. for the State.
3. By means of this writ petition, petitioners have impugned the FIR No.73 of 2025 lodged under Sections 323, 325, 376, 498-A, 504 and 120-B IPC registered at P.S. Jwalapur, Distt. Haridwar.
4. Issue notice to respondent no.5 returnable within four weeks.
Steps within a week.
5. Respondents may file their respective counter affidavits.

Learned counsel for the petitioners has argued that petitioner no.1 is the husband whereas petitioner nos.2 and 3 are the father-in-law and mother-in-law of respondent no.5; petitioners even joined the investigation, and subsequently, Section 376 IPC was added.
Feeling apprehension, they have approached this Court.

8. It is further contended that offence of Section 376 IPC cannot be alleged against petitioner no.1 who is husband of respondent no.5 and they both have a child aged about eight years; petitioner no.2 who is father in law is now about 67 years of age; petitioner no.3 who is mother-in-law is 63 years of age; both are aged and ailing.9 9.
Per contra, learned State Counsel submitted that serious offences have been alleged against the petitioners.

WPCRL/216/2025 on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116655421/
1 10.

It is pertinent to mention that as per the pleadings of writ petition, petitioner nos.1 and 2 have now been arrested by the police, as is mentioned by petitioners themselves in paragraph no.8 of the petition.
Since petitioner nos.1 and 2 have already been arrested, no order can be passed qua them regarding protection.

10. Insofar as petitioner no.3 is concerned, who is the mother in law of respondent no.5 and an old lady, it is directed that till the next date of listing, no coercive measure shall be adopted against petitioner no.3 qua the impugned FIR till the next date of listing.
11. Interim relief application (IA/1/2025) stands disposed of.

12. Let a copy of this order be supplied to the parties today itself on payment of usual charges.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) 12.03.2025 R.Dang WPCRL/216/2025 on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116655421/
